ratingRule.competitive: any rater says Toss-up or Tilt, OR the market top contract is between 0.35 and 0.65 inclusive
ratingRule.safe: otherwise, every listed rater says Likely/Solid/Safe, OR the market top contract is above 0.85
ratingRule.unsure: everything else (including races with no rater and no market)
ratingRule.order: rules are applied in the order competitive -> leans -> safe -> unsure
ratingRule.marketPrice: midpoint of yes bid/ask when both exist, else last trade price; Kalshi first, Polymarket only where no Kalshi market was found; PredictIt is supplementary and never used for the rating
ratingRule.priorResults: never used for the rating; shown only as labeled "prior result" with an official source

_meta.raterCoverage: Cook, Sabato and Inside Elections rate only federal and governor races; down-ballot races rely on markets alone.
displayRules: Never name a favored candidate in prose; never use the words leading, trailing or favored.
Show market caption with the source name; for Polymarket show the fallback caption.

Kalshi.summary: Kalshi Data Terms: personal, non-commercial use only, in the form presented on the website; publicly displaying, publishing, redistributing, compiling or caching Kalshi Data requires prior written authorization. Developer Agreement v1.1 limits API use to facilitating the member's own trading. Public display on townhall.town needs written permission from Kalshi.

Polymarket.summary: ToS bars harvesting or collecting information from the site for any unauthorized purpose; Builders Code of Conduct says the terms prohibit reselling or redistributing data to capital-markets firms or market-data distributors without written agreement. No explicit public-display licence found; confirm with Polymarket before display.

PredictIt.apiNote: API FAQ (predictit.org/api/about/faqs, as quoted by settledmarkets.com): "This data is for non-commercial use and PredictIt shall be attributed as the source."
PredictIt.summary: Non-commercial use with attribution to PredictIt; site terms prohibit scraping the website and commercial use. The FAQ wording was not read first-hand this turn.

Cook Political Report.summary: Ratings pages direct users to Cook's terms of use; API/licensed access is by request. Quote the rating with attribution and link; get permission for systematic reuse.

Sabato's Crystal Ball.summary: Ratings are published as images; only text from the rating-changes log was used. Attribute and link.

Inside Elections.summary: Ratings read from the site's public ratings cache JSON that backs the ratings maps; no separate data licence found. Attribute and link; ask before systematic reuse.

_meta.contestStatusNote: contestStatus is a ballot fact, not a rating; uncontested and retention races stay unsure under the rating rule because no rater or market covers them.
